hypothesis: Broad market regimes can overwhelm individual relative-strength pullbacks. Long strong-coin pullbacks only when BTC trends up and short weak-coin rebounds only when BTC trends down may reduce the large bear-market drawdown.
single_variable: Merge the two already-priced, symmetric 360-contract pullback/rebound branches into one fully funded nine-slot account. Change only the allowed side according to BTC's most recent completed UTC daily close versus its 200-day simple moving average. Close above = allow long; close below = allow short. The full 200-day observation must be contiguous and complete. Opposite regime and unrestricted two-sided accounts use the identical covered time period. Absolute 30-day relative strength to BTC remains the entry ranking, exits and cash sizing unchanged.
comparison: Also on matched original/later pairs, each trade must satisfy the regime at its own timestamp. Opposite and unrestricted groups are diagnostics. Costs 5bp each market fill, separately add 5bp adverse market slippage to the regime-following account. All later years previously examined; inherited source gaps and administrative exits require further checks for a surviving candidate. No funding.
